# Ireland Total Overhaul player-facing historical, crisis, material, Northern and postwar event programme.
# Allocation in this file: 72 historical/institutional, 45 political crisis, 48 Provision/Readiness/neutrality, 32 Northern settlement/integration, 30 foreign reactions and 24 postwar/conclusion nodes, plus the reaction digest, the explicit Otherworld archive reveal, and three supplemental lifecycle nodes; 256 authored standard definitions in total.
# Family registry: H01-H18 (72), P01-P18 (45), N01-N09 (48), NR01-NR08 (32), FR01-FR12 (30), PW01-PW04 (24), FR-DIGEST (1), A19 Otherworld reveal (1).
# H/P/A gates are inline. Every event stores persistent memory, scales effects from a live Ireland ledger, supplies AI chance, and clears ephemeral event state.

# H01 1937 Constitution and Ninth Dail | H | node 1/4 | actor: cabinet, Dail and civic organisations | knowledge: the published draft, separate vote ledgers and commencement timetable
country_event = {
	id = ireland_events.100
	title = ireland_events.constitution_cabinet_draft.t
	desc = ireland_events.constitution_cabinet_draft.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_ireland_report_historical_chain_report_01
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_100 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		date > 1937.1.1
		date < 1938.1.1
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_h01_gateway
			date > 1937.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_100
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_100_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.constitution_cabinet_draft.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h01_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h01_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_h01_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_100_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_constitution_cabinet_draft_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_social_consent }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_national_settlement = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_national_settlement min = constant:ireland.settlement_min max = constant:ireland.settlement_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_social_consent = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_social_consent min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_h01_accepted
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_h01
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.constitution_cabinet_draft.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h01_preferred_b }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h01_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_h01_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_100_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_constitution_cabinet_draft_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_social_consent }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_national_settlement = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_national_settlement min = constant:ireland.settlement_min max = constant:ireland.settlement_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_social_consent = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_social_consent min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_h01_deferred
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_h01
	}
	after = {
		ireland_recompute_provision = yes
		ireland_recompute_readiness = yes
		ireland_update_settlement_stage = yes
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_100_a
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_100_b
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_100_open
		set_country_flag = ireland_followup_constitution_cabinet_draft_closed
}
}

		}
		OR = {

			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h04_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h04_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_h04_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_115_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_emergency_six_month_review_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_neutrality_integrity }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_neutrality_integrity = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_neutrality_integrity min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_social_consent = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_social_consent min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_h04_accepted
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_h04

	option = {

			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_h04_preferred_b }

	title = ireland_events.camp_parole.t
	desc = ireland_events.camp_parole.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		has_country_flag = ireland_followup_camp_health_closed
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_n03_accepted
			has_country_flag = ireland_n03_deferred
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_234 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		date > 1939.1.1
		date < 1946.1.1
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_internment_incident_active
			date > 1939.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_234
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_234_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.camp_parole.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n03_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n03_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_n03_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_234_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_camp_parole_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_neutrality_integrity }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_neutrality_integrity = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_neutrality_integrity min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_social_consent = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_social_consent min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_n03_accepted
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_n03
		ireland_close_neutrality_incident = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.camp_parole.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n03_preferred_b }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n03_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_n03_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_234_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_camp_parole_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_neutrality_integrity }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_neutrality_integrity = ireland_event_delta }

	id = ireland_events.249
	title = ireland_events.trade_good.t
	desc = ireland_events.trade_good.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_249 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		date > 1939.1.1
		date < 1949.1.1
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_trade_incident_active
			date > 1939.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_249
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_249_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.trade_good.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n06_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n06_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_n06_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_249_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_trade_good_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_provision_transport }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_transport = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_transport min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_display = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_display min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_n06_accepted
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_n06
		ireland_close_neutrality_incident = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.trade_good.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n06_preferred_b }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_n06_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_n06_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_249_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_trade_good_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_provision_transport }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_transport = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_transport min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_display = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_display min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_n06_deferred
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_n06
		ireland_close_neutrality_incident = yes
	}
	after = {
		ireland_recompute_provision = yes
		ireland_recompute_readiness = yes
		ireland_update_settlement_stage = yes
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_249_a
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_249_b
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_249_open
		set_country_flag = ireland_followup_trade_good_closed
}
}

	id = ireland_events.274
	title = ireland_events.northern_labour_dispute.t
	desc = ireland_events.northern_labour_dispute.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		has_country_flag = ireland_followup_northern_linen_workers_closed
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_accepted
			has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_deferred
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_274 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			check_variable = { var = ireland_national_settlement value = constant:ireland.settlement_route_min compare = greater_than }
		}
		date > 1936.1.1
		date < 1956.1.1
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_northern_industry_open
			date > 1936.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_274
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_274_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.northern_labour_dispute.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_274_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_northern_labour_dispute_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_northern_labour_cooperation }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_northern_labour_cooperation = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_northern_labour_cooperation min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_northern_integration_capacity = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_northern_integration_capacity min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_nr02_accepted
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_nr02
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.northern_labour_dispute.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_preferred_b }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_nr02_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_274_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_northern_labour_dispute_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_northern_labour_cooperation }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_northern_labour_cooperation = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_northern_labour_cooperation min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_northern_integration_capacity = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_northern_integration_capacity min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_nr02_deferred
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_nr02
	}
	after = {
		ireland_recompute_provision = yes
		ireland_recompute_readiness = yes
		ireland_update_settlement_stage = yes
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_274_a
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_274_b
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_274_open
		set_country_flag = ireland_followup_northern_labour_dispute_closed
}
}

	id = ireland_events.298
	picture = GFX_news_event_ireland_news_historical_news_01
	title = ireland_events.northern_labour_settlement.t
	desc = ireland_events.northern_labour_settlement.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		has_country_flag = ireland_followup_northern_unitary_option_closed
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_accepted
			has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_deferred
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_298 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			check_variable = { var = ireland_national_settlement value = constant:ireland.settlement_route_min compare = greater_than }
		}
		date > 1936.1.1
		date < 1956.1.1
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_northern_order_open
			date > 1936.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_298
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_298_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.northern_labour_settlement.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_298_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_northern_labour_settlement_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_northern_british_flexibility }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_northern_british_flexibility = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_northern_british_flexibility min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_british_leverage = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_british_leverage min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_nr08_accepted
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_nr08
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.northern_labour_settlement.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_preferred_b }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_nr08_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_298_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_northern_labour_settlement_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_northern_british_flexibility }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_northern_british_flexibility = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_northern_british_flexibility min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_british_leverage = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_british_leverage min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_nr08_deferred
		ireland_open_foreign_reaction_window = yes
		set_country_flag = ireland_foreign_reaction_subject_nr08
	}
	after = {
		ireland_recompute_provision = yes
		ireland_recompute_readiness = yes
		ireland_update_settlement_stage = yes
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_298_a
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_298_b
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_298_open
		set_country_flag = ireland_followup_northern_labour_settlement_closed
}
}

		}

		date < 1956.1.1

			has_country_flag = ireland_postwar_transition
			date > 1945.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active

			base = 60

			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_pw01_pressure }

		set_country_flag = ireland_event_300_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_postwar_emergency_expiry_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_neutrality_integrity }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }

	id = ireland_events.308
	title = ireland_events.postwar_merchant_fleet.t
	desc = ireland_events.postwar_merchant_fleet.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		has_country_flag = ireland_followup_postwar_rural_electrification_closed
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_accepted
			has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_deferred
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_308 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			check_variable = { var = ireland_national_settlement value = constant:ireland.settlement_route_min compare = greater_than }
		}
		date > 1945.1.1
		date < 1956.1.1
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_reconstruction_active
			date > 1945.1.1
		}
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera
			has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active
			has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_308
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_308_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.postwar_merchant_fleet.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_preferred_a }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_308_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_postwar_merchant_fleet_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_provision_energy }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_energy = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_energy min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_display = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_display min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_pw02_accepted
		ireland_begin_conclusion_review = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_events.postwar_merchant_fleet.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_preferred_b }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_pressure }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 has_country_flag = ireland_pw02_historical_preference }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_event_308_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_postwar_merchant_fleet_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = ireland_provision_energy }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = constant:ireland.provision_component_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_event_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_energy = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_energy min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_provision_display = ireland_event_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_provision_display min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		set_country_flag = ireland_pw02_deferred
	}
	after = {
		ireland_recompute_provision = yes
		ireland_recompute_readiness = yes
		ireland_update_settlement_stage = yes
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_308_a
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_308_b
		clr_country_flag = ireland_event_308_open
		set_country_flag = ireland_followup_postwar_merchant_fleet_closed
}
}
